name: baseball bat
description: Ash, thirty-two inches, someone's name in marker on the knob. Forgiving in a way nothing else here is — a bad swing still connects — and it carries across the street.
notes: T81 · blunt, 'forgiving, durable, tiring, some noise' (GDD IX) read literally: the best damage spread outside the axe, the second-best reach, wear 1 on 80 = eighty swings — bought with noise 25 and no answer to armor at all.
